Alternative.description: A candidate the decision chooses among (a configuration, a source, a design).

id.description: Logical identifier, authored with a type prefix (alt:, req:, meas:, obs:, ev:, crit:, rc:, ...).

is_incumbent.description: The design or source already in place; used by the omitted-options bias check.

mapping_rule.description: The mapping rule that produced this object, and any lossy interpretation.

source_element.description: Identifier of the source element (e.g. a SysML qualified name).

Alternative.title: Alternative

Any.description: Any value; used only for change-set assignments.
Any.title: Any

Applicability.description: Whether an observation's evidence applies to the alternative it is attached to.
Applicability.title: Applicability

AssessmentStatus.description: Outcome of a test. Unknown means the inputs needed to decide were missing or not accepted.
AssessmentStatus.title: AssessmentStatus

Assumption.description: A parameter taken as given. Critical assumptions must be validated before authorization.

id.description: Logical identifier, authored with a type prefix (alt:, req:, meas:, obs:, ev:, crit:, rc:, ...).

owner_role.description: The role that must act when this object needs a human (review, acceptance, data).

unit.description: Unit string, matched exactly (no conversion). "1" means dimensionless.

Assumption.title: Assumption

BiasCheck.description: A readiness condition that tests for a bias: in decision framing (an omitted alternative, a criterion counted twice) or in model output (a score resting on an unstated source).

id.description: Logical identifier, authored with a type prefix (alt:, req:, meas:, obs:, ev:, crit:, rc:, ...).

owner_role.description: The role that must act when this object needs a human (review, acceptance, data).

required.description: Default true. Conditions that are not required are reported but do not gate readiness.

BiasCheck.title: BiasCheck

ChangeSet.description: One episode's change from its parent: assignments to existing objects (assign), new objects (add, a partial decision state), and removals by id. A change set is kept only if the resulting state validates. Human actions (reviews, approvals) are recorded by adding or assigning them here.

as_of.description: The state's clock; evidence expiry and approval validity are judged against it.

id.description: Logical identifier, authored with a type prefix (alt:, req:, meas:, obs:, ev:, crit:, rc:, ...).

ChangeSet.title: ChangeSet

CheckOutcome.description: One requirement check, in the common g <= 0 convention.

unit.description: Unit string, matched exactly (no conversion). "1" means dimensionless.

CheckOutcome.title: CheckOutcome

Claim.description: An assessment of a proposition, with the reasoning basis that produced it: computed (an evaluator or check), semantic (an agent's interpretation), or human (a recorded judgement).

id.description: Logical identifier, authored with a type prefix (alt:, req:, meas:, obs:, ev:, crit:, rc:, ...).

produced_by.description: The node (and so the evaluation run) or recorded action that produced the claim.

source_locator.description: The passage a claim's value was taken from: document, section, page and exact quote (from the observation's SourceLocator), marked when it cites an earlier version of the document.

Claim.title: Claim

required.description: Default true. Conditions that are not required are reported but do not gate readiness.

Criterion.description: A preference criterion: a value function v mapping a measure onto [0, 1] with fixed anchors, and a weight. Linear by default, v = (y - anchor_worst) / (anchor_best - anchor_worst), so a cost criterion has anchor_worst above anchor_best. Fixed anchors keep scores from moving when an alternative is added. Weights express trade-offs over these scales and must sum to 1.

clip.description: Clip values to [0, 1] outside the anchors (default true).

id.description: Logical identifier, authored with a type prefix (alt:, req:, meas:, obs:, ev:, crit:, rc:, ...).

points.description: Optional piecewise-linear value function; overrides the linear form between the anchors.

Criterion.title: Criterion

as_of.description: The state's clock; evidence expiry and approval validity are judged against it.

evpi.description: Expected value of perfect information about every uncertain input (utility points).

question.description: The decision question in plain words.

robust.description: On a scenario outcome, the baseline recommendation is feasible and uniquely best in that scenario; on a record, in every scenario of the declared set.

source_path.description: Where the evaluated state or program was read from (as given), so the record can be replayed.

state_digest.description: Digest of the decision state the approval covered (stamped by the kernel).

DecisionProgram.description: A decision maintained over time, from a baseline state through successive change sets.

baseline_dir.description: Directory of the baseline state's files, relative to program.yaml (default baseline/).

changes_dir.description: Directory of change-set files, relative to program.yaml (default changes/).

id.description: Logical identifier, authored with a type prefix (alt:, req:, meas:, obs:, ev:, crit:, rc:, ...).

question.description: The decision question in plain words.

DecisionProgram.title: DecisionProgram

DecisionRule.description: How feasible alternatives are ranked. additive_mavt maximizes U(a) = sum_k w_k v_k(y_k(a)) and returns the set of alternatives within tie_tolerance of the maximum.

chance_alpha.description: Joint chance constraint tolerance; feasible iff Pr(all mandatory checks pass) >= 1 - alpha.

id.description: Logical identifier, authored with a type prefix (alt:, req:, meas:, obs:, ev:, crit:, rc:, ...).

seed.description: Random seed for expected_mavt; recorded so runs replay exactly.

tie_tolerance.description: Alternatives within this utility of the maximum are tied (default 1.0e-9).

DecisionRule.title: DecisionRule

DecisionState.description: One decision state (or a part of one, while it is split across files).

as_of.description: The state's clock; evidence expiry and approval validity are judged against it.

question.description: The decision question in plain words.

DecisionState.title: DecisionState

EvaluationRun.description: One node evaluation; the signature identifies its exact inputs and implementation.
EvaluationRun.title: EvaluationRun

EvaluationSpecification.description: A computation producing one or more measures for each alternative it applies to. A python spec's implementation is "path/to/module.py:function" (relative to the decision's directory) or "package.module:function"; the function receives the bound inputs and parameters as keyword arguments (by arg) and returns a number, or a dict keyed by output arg. A linear_combination spec returns intercept + sum(coefficient_<arg> * input), with intercept and coefficients given as parameters.

applies_to.description: Alternatives this applies to; empty means all.

cost_units.description: Relative cost of one run (default 1), used to weight recomputation savings.

deterministic.description: Default true. A non-deterministic evaluator is never reused from a previous run.

environment.description: Declared runtime requirements (e.g. "numpy>=2"); part of the signature.

id.description: Logical identifier, authored with a type prefix (alt:, req:, meas:, obs:, ev:, crit:, rc:, ...).

owner_role.description: The role that must act when this object needs a human (review, acceptance, data).

EvaluationSpecification.title: EvaluationSpecification

Evidence.description: A source document or data product. An empty source_ref means the source is unstated.

content_sha256.description: Digest of the source content, so a changed file is a changed input.

document_digest.description: Digest of an indexed document's headings and section texts (pdo docs index). On Evidence it is the current version; on a locator, the version the locator was made against. Written by the pdo docs tools. Whole-file identity stays with content_sha256; leave it empty for a document whose values carry section locators, so a revision is judged section by section.

document_path.description: The indexed document (.docx, .pdf, .md or .txt), relative to the state or program directory. Several evidence items may share one document (e.g. one section each). On a locator, the file of the version the locator was made against.

evidence_kind.description: Kind of source (cost estimate, test report, specification, simulation output).

id.description: Logical identifier, authored with a type prefix (alt:, req:, meas:, obs:, ev:, crit:, rc:, ...).

mapping_rule.description: The mapping rule that produced this object, and any lossy interpretation.

owner_role.description: The role that must act when this object needs a human (review, acceptance, data).

source_element.description: Identifier of the source element (e.g. a SysML qualified name).

source_ref.description: Citation or locator of the source; empty means unstated (fails evidence traceability).

valid_until.description: After this date the evidence is stale and readiness becomes pending until it is refreshed.

Evidence.title: Evidence

ExecutableDecisionState.description: A decision state complete enough to run.

as_of.description: The state's clock; evidence expiry and approval validity are judged against it.

question.description: The decision question in plain words.

ExecutableDecisionState.title: ExecutableDecisionState

FlipDirection.description: Whether the flip point lies above or below the baseline value.
FlipDirection.title: FlipDirection

FlipPoint.description: A value of one input at which the recommendation changes, all other inputs held fixed.

counterpart.description: For a weight flip, the criterion whose weight absorbs the shift (the other weights held fixed).

crossing.description: The quantity whose zero is the boundary, e.g. "U/alt:B - U/alt:A" (a utility margin) or "g/req:max-cost/alt:B" (a requirement check).

previous_recommendation.description: The recommendation on the baseline side of the flip point.

verified.description: Re-running just below and just above the flip point gives the two recommendations reported.

FlipPoint.title: FlipPoint

HumanApproval.description: A recorded authorization of one alternative. The kernel stamps the state digest it covered; the decision is actionable only while the recommendation, readiness and that digest still match.

id.description: Logical identifier, authored with a type prefix (alt:, req:, meas:, obs:, ev:, crit:, rc:, ...).

recorded_in_episode.description: Episode in which the action was recorded (stamped by the kernel).

state_digest.description: Digest of the decision state the approval covered (stamped by the kernel).

valid_until.description: After this date the evidence is stale and readiness becomes pending until it is refreshed.

HumanApproval.title: HumanApproval

HumanReview.description: A recorded review of a set of objects. The kernel stamps the digest of what it covered when the review is recorded; if any covered object changes later, the review is stale and counts as pending.

covered_digest.description: Digest of the covered objects when the review was recorded (stamped by the kernel).

covers.description: Ids of reviewed objects, or selectors "all:<collection>" (e.g. all:criteria, all:alternatives).

id.description: Logical identifier, authored with a type prefix (alt:, req:, meas:, obs:, ev:, crit:, rc:, ...).

owner_role.description: The role that must act when this object needs a human (review, acceptance, data).

recorded_in_episode.description: Episode in which the action was recorded (stamped by the kernel).

HumanReview.title: HumanReview

ImpactSummary.description: What a change touched, and what was rerun versus reused.
ImpactSummary.title: ImpactSummary

InputBinding.description: One input of a spec: either a measure (the same alternative's value of it) or a reference to a specific object such as an Assumption. The unit must match the bound source's unit exactly.

arg.description: Argument name: the keyword an evaluator receives for this input, output or parameter. Unlike a display name it is part of the computation, so it is hashable.

unit.description: Unit string, matched exactly (no conversion). "1" means dimensionless.

id.description: Logical identifier, authored with a type prefix (alt:, req:, meas:, obs:, ev:, crit:, rc:, ...).

locator.description: The passage of the evidence's document this value was taken from.

arg.description: Argument name: the keyword an evaluator receives for this input, output or parameter. Unlike a display name it is part of the computation, so it is hashable.

worth_resolving.description: The EVPPI's 90% bootstrap interval excludes zero.

SlotAssignment.description: Set one slot of one object, identified by id, to a new value.
SlotAssignment.title: SlotAssignment

SourceLocator.description: Where in an indexed document a value was taken from: the document and section digests, the section's id and heading path, the page and paragraph, and the exact quote with its surrounding text and its character span in the section text. Written by the pdo docs tools, which refuse a quote that is not in the document; never written by hand. A locator locates a value without being part of it, so it is unhashable (as DAPPER treats representation locators): re-anchoring it to a new version of the document changes no digest, and the locators_current readiness predicate checks it instead.

char_end.description: End of the quote in the section text, exclusive (TextPositionSelector end).

char_start.description: Start of the quote in the section text (TextPositionSelector start).

document_digest.description: Digest of an indexed document's headings and section texts (pdo docs index). On Evidence it is the current version; on a locator, the version the locator was made against. Written by the pdo docs tools. Whole-file identity stays with content_sha256; leave it empty for a document whose values carry section locators, so a revision is judged section by section.

document_path.description: The indexed document (.docx, .pdf, .md or .txt), relative to the state or program directory. Several evidence items may share one document (e.g. one section each). On a locator, the file of the version the locator was made against.

quote.description: The exact passage stating the value, as normalized by pdo docs (TextQuoteSelector exact).

quote_prefix.description: Up to 32 characters before the quote in the section (TextQuoteSelector prefix).

quote_suffix.description: Up to 32 characters after the quote in the section (TextQuoteSelector suffix).

section.description: Section id in the document's outline, e.g. "3.2" ("0" is text before the first heading).

section_digest.description: Digest of the section's normalized body text (not its heading). Equal digests in two versions of a document mean the cited text did not change.

section_path.description: Heading path of the section, e.g. "3 Results > 3.2 Vehicle B".

SourceLocator.title: SourceLocator

source_element.description: Identifier of the source element (e.g. a SysML qualified name).
